summary: The agent provides a solid baseline solution with good feature engineering and a robust 5-fold cross-validation setup. However, it fails to perform any exploratory data cleaning or basic preprocessing checks. Furthermore, the agent tunes its classification threshold directly on the out-of-fold predictions and uses that same tuned threshold to report validation accuracy, resulting in an overly optimistic evaluation.
